description:
Hannan here! a Mechanical Engineering student at NUST. Mathematical modelling is my superpower, with particular interests in tensors, GR, Clifford algebra, and 7 years of programming experience in roblox and unity.

Lunar Locus aims to, Through the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser, build an interactive platform to analyse lunar landing sites, model illumination, examine Earth visibility, explore communication opportunities and identify viable mission windows.
summary:
Lunar Site Explorer is an interactive 3D experience developed in Roblox Studio to explore the challenges of selecting lunar south-pole landing sites. Built using NASA-derived lunar elevation data and integrated with NASA/JPL Horizons, it allows users to navigate realistic terrain, select geographical coordinates, and investigate the apparent positions of the Sun and Earth at different observation times.

By visualising azimuth, elevation, and visibility relative to the local horizon, the project demonstrates how location and time influence solar illumination and opportunities for direct communication with Earth.

It makes complex lunar environmental conditions more accessible through an intuitive, interactive experience, supporting preliminary exploration, education, and public engagement with future lunar missions.
details:
Lunar Site Explorer is an 3d interactive game that allows the player to visualise the terrain and position of Earth and Sun at any position on the south pole. It is rapid, intuitive and easy to use.

The project allows full controlled movement over the surface and the ability to click anywhere on the south pole terrain (generated using data from NASA MoonTrek) to deploy themselves at that location.

By selecting a date and time, the Earth and Sun are also displayed in 3d, and the player can interactively move around the camera to visually see the location of the Sun and Earth and how their visibility is blocked by the train.

The project is intended to rapidly visualise any possible location on the south pole and to be intuitive and accessible for comprehension by the general public.

The project was created using LuaScript on roblox studio, python was also used in generating a height map from Moon Trek data. The roblox experience is open and anyone with a roblox account can play.

The entire project and scripts are also available on github.
